title: MWS 3-year resurvey — Medical History
description: Illnesses in the past 5 years, conditions currently being treated, and overall self-rated health, reported at the 3-year resurvey. 5 of the 8 'treated now' fields have a matching 'illness in the past 5 years' field, but steward confirmed no skip logic is needed -- same reasoning as recruitment's medical_history (D032): an illness answer of No does not force the corresponding treated-now field to a structural-NA code.

F1HDIS.title: Illness in past 5 years: heart disease/problem
F1HDIS.$comment: Checkbox-style: only '1=Yes' documented, no '2=No', no skip pattern -- D079. Available on every questionnaire version.

F1CLEG.title: Illness in past 5 years: clot in leg

F1CHOL.title: Illness in past 5 years: high blood cholesterol

F1BP.title: Illness in past 5 years: high blood pressure
F1BP.$comment: Same checkbox-style treatment as F1HDIS. No skip pair against F1TRBP (treated now: high blood pressure) -- steward-confirmed, D079.

F1AST.title: Illness in past 5 years: asthma
F1AST.$comment: Same checkbox-style treatment as F1HDIS. No skip pair against F1TRAST -- steward-confirmed, D079.

F1GALL.title: Illness in past 5 years: gallstones / gall bladder problems

F1OPOR.title: Illness in past 5 years: osteoporosis
F1OPOR.$comment: Same checkbox-style treatment as F1HDIS. No skip pair against F1TROPOR -- steward-confirmed, D079.

F1BRCA.title: Illness in past 5 years: breast cancer

F1OTCA.title: Illness in past 5 years: other cancer

F1TRBP.title: Treated now: high blood pressure
F1TRBP.$comment: Checkbox-style, same as F1HDIS. Has a matching illness field (F1BP), but steward confirmed no skip logic is needed -- D079.

F1TRHDIS.title: Treated now: heart disease
F1TRHDIS.$comment: Checkbox-style, same as F1HDIS. Has a matching illness field (F1HDIS), no skip logic -- D079.

F1TRDIAB.title: Treated now: diabetes
F1TRDIAB.$comment: Checkbox-style, same as F1HDIS. Has a matching illness field (F1DIAB), no skip logic -- D079.

F1TRAST.title: Treated now: asthma
F1TRAST.$comment: Checkbox-style, same as F1HDIS. Has a matching illness field (F1AST), no skip logic -- D079.

F1TRRA.title: Treated now: rheumatoid arthritis
F1TRRA.$comment: Checkbox-style, same as F1HDIS. No matching illness field in this sheet at all -- no trigger variable exists to gate this field regardless.

F1TROA.title: Treated now: osteoarthritis
F1TROA.$comment: Checkbox-style, same as F1HDIS. No matching illness field in this sheet.

F1TROPOR.title: Treated now: osteoporosis
F1TROPOR.$comment: Checkbox-style, same as F1HDIS. Has a matching illness field (F1OPOR), no skip logic -- D079.

F1TRDEP.title: Treated now: depression/anxiety
F1TRDEP.$comment: Checkbox-style, same as F1HDIS. No matching illness field in this sheet.

F1HEALTH.title: Overall health now
F1HEALTH.$comment: Not available on the 9903/9907 versions -- its own version-gated -1='Not on questionnaire' code lines up cleanly, unenforced against F1QTYPE like the package's other such fields. Unlike the other 20 fields in this category, this is a genuine 4-level rating scale, not a checkbox.
